certified_wrong_top_class.definition: per cell, share of no-correction certified-wrong positions at 0.25 whose selected class is the most frequent selected class among them; cells with zero such positions excluded

changed_positions.definition: number of positions (of all cells) whose standard-CA indicator at radius 0.25 (not abstained, selected == truth, radius >= 0.25) differs from no correction

clean_gate.exact_count_rule: macro drop <= 1.0 point and every cell drop <= 2.0 points with drops computed as 100*(correct_ref - correct_cand)/n using fractions.Fraction
clean_gate.written_rule: macro drop <= 1.0 points and every cell drop <= 2.0 points

distinct_classifiers.definition: number of candidates with pairwise-distinct per-example decisions (raw prediction, selected smoothed class, abstention) over all 12 cells; candidates sharing every decision are one classifier

derivations.equal_cell_macro: unweighted mean over the 12 model-dataset-fold cells, recomputed from per_candidate_cells and checked against candidate_aggregates_equal_cell_weight (tolerance 1e-9)

exp021_design.power: registered power block of EXP-021A (at discordance 0.10) and EXP-021B (pooled over datasets per sigma and EuroSAT sealed, at discordance 0.10)
exp021_design.unique_images: sum of item_count over distinct evaluation_items_sha256 values per registration

extension.primary_cells_rule: cells of EXP-019A minus the CIFAR-10 cells at the EXP-017 sigma, which the registration labels a secondary bridge
extension.unique_items: sum of item_count over distinct evaluation_items_sha256 values across EXP-019A and EXP-019B

extension_EXP-20260920-019A.clean_delta_definition: equal-cell mean over the primary cells of (candidate - no_correction) clean accuracy, points
extension_EXP-20260920-019A.delta_definition: equal-cell mean over the primary cells of (candidate - no_correction) standard CA at r = sigma, points
extension_EXP-20260920-019A.x3_rule: the learned shared-translation (tangent) control interval contains zero
extension_EXP-20260920-019A.x4_rule: addendum A2.3: at least one per-class control (noisy class mean, rank-8 tangent adapter) has a lower band limit above zero
extension_EXP-20260920-019A.x5_rule: addendum A1: identity-bank top-class share and predicted-class Gini both strictly increase with sigma within every model x dataset (bridge cells included); 'supported' or 'not uniformly supported', no inferential statement

extension_EXP-20260920-019B.clean_delta_definition: equal-cell mean over the primary cells of (candidate - no_correction) clean accuracy, points
extension_EXP-20260920-019B.delta_definition: equal-cell mean over the primary cells of (candidate - no_correction) standard CA at r = sigma, points
extension_EXP-20260920-019B.x3_rule: the learned shared-translation (tangent) control interval contains zero
extension_EXP-20260920-019B.x4_rule: addendum A2.3: at least one per-class control (noisy class mean, rank-8 tangent adapter) has a lower band limit above zero
extension_EXP-20260920-019B.x5_rule: addendum A1: identity-bank top-class share and predicted-class Gini both strictly increase with sigma within every model x dataset (bridge cells included); 'supported' or 'not uniformly supported', no inferential statement

extension_custody.unblinding: D-127 owner-instructed unblinding; registered primary analysis outputs are primary-only

extension_regime_ranges.definition: min and max over the identity-bank cells at the given sigma across the available registered experiments

failure_partition.cross_check: per-cell counts equal the audit's failure_causes_at_0.25 for no_correction and the GR-CLIP candidate

definitions.anchored_certified_correct_at_target: certified correct at 0.25 and selected == raw clean prediction
definitions.certified_correct_at_target: not abstained, selected == truth, certificate radius >= 0.25
definitions.certified_wrong_at_target: not abstained, selected != truth, certificate radius >= 0.25
definitions.correct_smoothed_class_but_radius_below_: not abstained, selected == truth, certificate radius < 0.25
definitions.nonabstaining_anchor_mismatch: not abstained and selected smoothed class != raw clean prediction
definitions.nonabstaining_wrong_smoothed_class: not abstained and selected smoothed class != ground truth

gate_n2.finite_stratum_sensitivity: descriptive only: half width = common critical value x sqrt(5/4)

gr_by_dataset.definition: unweighted mean over the cells of one dataset of (GR-CLIP standard CA - no-correction standard CA) at radius 0.25

radius_per_coordinate.formula: target radius / sqrt(channels x crop_size x crop_size), two significant digits, for math mode

standard_minus_anchored.definition: equal-cell standard CA minus equal-cell anchored CA at radius 0.25, checked against the audit's standard_minus_anchored

weighting.pooled_delta: sum_c n_c (CA_cand,c - CA_ref,c) / sum_c n_c, in points, from exact per-cell counts
weighting.weights: w_i = 1/(12 n_c) for every item in cell c

macros.ExtAMaxGridId: noisy-margin step 0.04 and two-sided centering c=1
macros.ExtXfiveSummary: supported in Extension A but not uniformly supported in Extension B
macros.ExtXfourFlags: both per-class controls do so in both experiments
macros.ExtXfourSummary: confirmed in both Extension A and Extension B
macros.ExtXthreeSummary: confirmed in both Extension A and Extension B
macros.FUGRClasses: unresolved in direction and practically equivalent in magnitude at both noise levels
macros.FUQSixDsMaxMag: gain of at least the SESOI
macros.FUQSixDsMinMag: loss of at least the SESOI
macros.FUQSixHighMaxId: the image half of two-sided centering at $c=0.5$
macros.FUQSixHighNegativeIds: the text half of two-sided centering at $c=1$ and the boundary-active proposal at step 0.16
macros.FUQSixLowNegativeIds: the text half of two-sided centering at $c=1$
macros.FUQThreeSummary: conforms in both Follow-ups, with no exception
macros.NthreeCPnine: two-sided c=1: 63,593 useful / 64,018 harmful; rank-8 adapter: 300,347 useful / 65,713 harmful
